expectations.text: B1: Explains the security issue and a minimal fix
expectations.evidence: Explains the issue: 'serving whatever path the request asks for is the classic path traversal (directory traversal) vulnerability' with examples (GET /../../etc/passwd, URL-encoded variants, .env secrets) and why blacklisting '..' is fragile.
